## Tool usage policy

- To create or replace a file, emit ONE `exec_command` call with `cmd` set to an `apply_patch` shell heredoc:

  The single-quoted heredoc passes content verbatim — do NOT double-escape backslashes inside the body. One file per call.
- To read or list files, use `exec_command` with `cat`, `ls`, `find`, or `rg`.
- To verify your work, use `exec_command` with `cargo check`, `cargo build`, or `cargo test`.
- Discover paths empirically — when the workdir or file location is unclear, list directories with `ls` or `find` BEFORE assuming a path. Do not invent or guess directory names.
